title: Exhaust — Thrust Reverser — Install the High Temperature Aft Seal and Reshape the Blocker Door Land
abstract: Shop-level conversion of the thrust reverser translating sleeve to the high temperature aft seal and the reshaped blocker door land, closing the leakage path that scorches the sleeve inner liner.

sections.planning_reason: Scorching and eventual liner delamination were found on the inner surface of the translating sleeve just forward of the blocker door land on aircraft above six thousand reverser cycles. The aft seal takes a compression set, opening a path that lets hot core gas track forward along the land. Thirty-four sleeves were found with liner damage over three years and eleven were beyond allowable repair limits. Operators running short sectors with reverse selected on every landing reach the condition fastest.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to replace the aft seal with the high temperature item carried on a metal carrier rather than a bonded strip, to reshape the blocker door land so that seal contact is maintained through the sleeve travel, and to extend the heat shield forward by 80 mm to cover the newly exposed liner edge. The retaining fasteners are renewed at every seal position and the shim set is used to establish the seal compression at build. The land reshaping is a machining operation and must be done in a qualified shop.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the thrust reverser and mount the translating sleeve in the shop stand. Remove the existing aft seal and the heat shield. Inspect the inner liner and record the condition; a sleeve with delamination beyond limits must be repaired before conversion. Machine the blocker door land to the profile given in the installation drawing, using the shop fixture, and confirm the profile against the gauge. Install the extended heat shield. Install the high temperature seal on its carrier, setting the compression with the shim set and renewing the retaining fasteners at every position. Confirm the seal contact through the full sleeve travel. Restore the surface treatment on the machined land. Reinstall the reverser and do the deployment and stow timing check using AMM-T-78-30-11-400-003-A. Confirm that the deployment and stow times are within the unchanged limits. Record the modification and update the reverser life record.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CVX-7270 powered TTN-88E1 aircraft. Auran powered aircraft carry a different sleeve and are not affected. Aircraft delivered from MSN T00213 have the standard from the production line. Reversers are converted individually and a mixed pair on one aircraft is acceptable in service.
sections.material_note: Kit K7830-1019-01 covers one reverser. Order four kits per aircraft. The high temperature seal is a twenty week lead item. The shim set is supplied as a selection and only the required thicknesses are consumed; the remainder should be retained for the next conversion.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled thrust reverser overhaul, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
